translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
ehal-e-kitab aur mushrikeen mein say jo log kafir thay , woh uss waqt tak baaz aaney walay nahi thay jab tak kay unn kay paas roshan daleel naa aati
yani aik Allah ka Rasool jo pak saheefay parh ker sunaye ,
jinn mein seedhi sachi tehreeren likhi hon .
aur jo ehal-e-kitab thay , unhon ney juda raasta ussi kay baad ikhtiyar kiya jab unn kay paas roshan daleel aa-chuki thi .

aur enhen iss kay siwa koi aur hukum nahi diya gaya tha kay woh Allah ki ibadat iss tarah keren kay bandagi ko bilkul yaksoo ho ker sirf ussi kay liye khaalis rakhen , aur namaz qaeem keren , aur zakat ada keren , aur yehi seedhi sachi ummat ka deen hai .
yaqeen jano kay ehal-e-kitab aur mushrikeen mein say jinhon ney kufr apna liya hai , woh jahannum ki aag mein jayen gay jahan woh hamesha rahen gay . yeh log sari makhlooq mein sabb say buray hain .
jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , woh beyshak sari makhlooq mein sabb say behtar hain .

unn kay perwerdigar kay paas unn ka inaam woh sada bahar jannaten hain jinn kay neechay say nehren behti hain . wahan woh hamesha hamesha rahen gay . Allah unn say khush hoga , aur woh uss say khush hon gay . yeh sabb kuch uss kay liye hai jo apney perwerdigar ka khof dil mein rakhta ho .
